note: PAPER ONLY. Squad 10 halal core baskets (SQ10-*). members = what each basket holds now with its weight today (weights set at the last review, then drifted with prices); a basket is meant to be owned WHOLE. The Shariah screen is a point-in-time PROXY of the S&P / Dow Jones / AAOIFI method, NOT ZAD: zad = the owner's ZAD mark (data/halal.json + zad-list), screener = HalalScreener (data/halal-ext.json); "unknown" must be checked before any real buy, and a member ZAD marks not halal is replaced by the first halal reserve. Entries and exits from 2026-10-26 are recorded in data/squad10-paper.jsonl.
